title: Machine learning screens cinnamic-acid derivatives for Leishmania enzyme inhibition
summary: Two random-forest classifiers and docking ranked an in-house set of cinnamic-acid derivatives; selected compounds were tested against recombinant L. major DHFR-TS. The paper reports IC50 values of 7.5, 6.1 and 10.1 µM for three named natural products versus 1.4 µM for methotrexate. These are enzyme assays, not whole-parasite treatment results.

evidence.tested: Primary article reports recombinant DHFR-TS inhibition for selected compounds and comparator.
evidence.unknown: Methods/results disagree on number of compounds; name/formula spellings and exact prior art need checking.
evidence.ai_role: RF models and docking prioritize a small compound set for biochemical enzyme assays.

source_review.scope: PMC-hosted primary full text; publisher primary article page. Material checked for the specific claims stated in the record.
